authority.scope_rule: Items 1-11 are pre-existing evidence and are NOT redefined, renumbered or touched here. This file ONLY enumerates 12-20.
authority.status_rule: Each case below carries a PRE-REGISTERED detection mechanism and fail-closed behaviour. Its PASS/FAIL status is measured at A7 re-audit time by executing test_ref (and only then); G3 does not pre-fill PASS for any item.

items.name: duplicate_trial_publication
items.trigger_description: The same scored trial (identical experiment identity/content digest) is offered to the append-only trial ledger twice, e.g. an operator rerun, a retried publish after a network hiccup, or a finalizer bug.
items.detection_mechanism: Exactly-once publication gate keyed on trial identity before delegation to research.global_ledger.append_verified; the registry digest identity is the entry content modulo the registry-stamped appended_at. Detection executed by the QA exactly-once oracle in tests/test_fault_injection_v10_g3.py (QAExactlyOncePublisher) and contractually by the adapter publish path.
items.expected_fail_closed_behavior: Second publication attempt raises/refuses with a duplicate reason; no additional row is written; the statistical denominator is unchanged after the rerun; verify_append_only stays True throughout.
items.recorded_limitation: research.global_ledger.append_verified enforces append-only monotonicity but has NO unique-experiment-id constraint: the raw registry alone does NOT close this case. The refusal MUST live in the adapter/finalizer publishing layer (BG-6).

items.name: missing_native_settlement_in_holding_span
items.trigger_description: A held leg spans a settlement-eligible interval with no published native funding rate (staged funding file short, symbol-specific cadence gap, or a rate published only outside the span).
items.detection_mechanism: Accrual-coverage detector over (start_ns, end_ns] per held span: any held span with zero settlements strictly inside is flagged. Duplicate publication timestamps are rejected structurally by research.pit_hooks_v10.normalize_info_series (DataIntegrityError).
items.expected_fail_closed_behavior: The span is marked UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED (never silently accrued as 0.0); with coverage_required the accrual result is unusable for scoring; malformed series raise DataIntegrityError before any cashflow is produced.

items.name: stale_artifact_manifest_hash
items.trigger_description: An artifact/manifest byte drifts after it was pinned (partial writer crash, truncation, post-hoc edit of a decision payload or input manifest).
items.detection_mechanism: Streaming sha256 (research.cache_v10.sha256_file_chunked) re-check of the pinned digest; chunk size must not change the digest, so any single-byte mutation or truncation is detected.
items.expected_fail_closed_behavior: Pinned digest != recomputed digest; the artifact is treated as tampered/unusable (mismatch raised or reported), never accepted as the pinned evidence.

items.name: post_cutoff_mutation_of_window_or_book_data
items.trigger_description: Book/window data is mutated AFTER the force-flat scored-window boundary (post-cutoff fill price forged, terminal force-flat reason rewritten, extra row appended beyond SCORED_WINDOW_END_UTC).
items.detection_mechanism: Scored-window slice hash re-check: hash the rows with SCORED_WINDOW_START_UTC < decision_ns <= SCORED_WINDOW_END_UTC and re-verify. A mutation dated after the cutoff cannot move the scored-window hash (out-of-window rows are structurally excluded), while any mutation inside the window - including the frozen terminal FORCE_FLAT row - changes the hash and is detected.
items.expected_fail_closed_behavior: Detected divergence refuses the artifact; the terminal row must keep action=FORCE_FLAT, reason=force_flat_final_scored_window_boundary and an empty book; holding spans may never extend past the boundary.

items.name: stale_cache_entry_reuse_across_changed_input_surface
items.trigger_description: A cached scored payload is offered back after ANY key-material component changed (data/catalog hash, symbols, window, bar type, funding model, signal inputs), or a cache object is smuggled across processes into a reproduction run.
items.detection_mechanism: research.cache_v10.make_cache_key hashes the FULL input surface (sorted-key canonical JSON), so any component change yields a different key and the stale entry becomes unreachable; research.cache_v10.ProcessLocalCache refuses pickling/copying so it cannot persist into a fresh reproduction process.
items.expected_fail_closed_behavior: Stale lookup is a recorded MISS returning no value (no silently-reused scored payload); persistence attempts raise TypeError; universe ordering never splits equivalent work (deterministic normalization).

items.name: over_cap_heavy_worker_launch
items.trigger_description: A heavy worker is launched when the effective cap is already reached: effective cap 0 (RAM-derived safe cap 0), a second concurrent acquire under cap 1, or a promotion attempt past the post-PnL cap snapshot.
items.detection_mechanism: research.resource_governor_v10.ResourceGovernorV10.admit_worker(active_count) compares the requested admission against effective_heavy_workers = min(contract_cap, ram_cap_workers) with the two-worker promotion rule and the post-PnL monotone clamp.
items.expected_fail_closed_behavior: OverCapacityError raised for every over-cap admission (including active=0 when the cap is 0: nothing may launch and cap 0 is never overridden to 1); promotion past 1 requires three consecutive safe two-worker probes; promotion after PnL is visible raises PromotionLockedError; invalid freeze parameters raise GovernorError.

items.name: incomplete_stress_matrix_finalization
items.trigger_description: A scored run tries to finalize while at least one preregistered stress variant produced no/invalid output (baseline, fee_slippage_x1_5, plus_2_ticks, plus_1_event_delay, drop_one_symbol:<SYMBOL> per cohort member, drop_one_fold:<LABEL> per fold), or an undeclared variant is present.
items.detection_mechanism: Refuse-finalize-if-any-required-variant-missing guard over the required variant-id grammar 'baseline | fee_slippage_x1_5 | plus_2_ticks | plus_1_event_delay | drop_one_symbol:<SYM> | drop_one_fold:<LABEL>', plus a required-result-key check (schema_version, variant_id, schedule_sha256, metrics) and an undeclared-variant check.
items.expected_fail_closed_behavior: Finalization raises naming the missing/malformed/undeclared variant ids; no score, no denominator update and no artifact finalization is produced from a partial matrix.

items.name: cross_fold_holding_span_leakage
items.trigger_description: A holding span opened inside chronological fold k survives past fold k's terminal boundary (through the purge gap) into fold k+1, or starts outside every fold window.
items.detection_mechanism: Cross-fold leakage detector over research.hyp_a8_m01.chronological_folds windows: the fold whose window contains span.start_ns owns the leg, and the leg may not remain open at/after that fold's close (purge already pushed the boundary one holding period ahead of the next fold).
items.expected_fail_closed_behavior: LeakageDetected raised naming the span and the folds it crosses; fold partitions must themselves be disjoint, chronological and purge-separated, so a detected overlap is a hard failure rather than a re-fold.

items.name: near_identical_result_reproduction_divergence
items.trigger_description: Two supposedly identical result payloads differ by exactly one ULP in a reported float, or by a missing key / sequence-length drift / type change (a rerun that is 'almost' the same).
items.detection_mechanism: Exact-equality reproduction comparator over the full nested payload (path-addressed): floats compared bit-exactly (repr equality, NaN==NaN by canonical convention), plus structural key-set and sequence-length checks.
items.expected_fail_closed_behavior: Any divergence is reported with the JSON path of the fault (e.g. $.metrics.expectancy:float_bit_mismatch); only byte-stable identical payloads compare clean; the strict shared-cache merge gate additionally rejects stale-read budgets even when every other proof is perfect.
